notes.title: FCS Update
notes.notes:
[h2]There's been a few updates as of late. Here's a short breakdown of what I've been working on lately. [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45204626/8f20c2d6c8ca064e13f964fd5c448651a8f6deaf.png[/img]
[expand type=showmore expanded=false]

[list]
[*] [h3] Unlock Product Categories [/h3] 
[list]
[*] Start with the [b]Food[/b] category unlocked. 
[*] Unlock more categories in the "Business Management" tab of your PC
[*] FUTURE: ...
[/list]
[*] [h3] Shushan Shop Shupplys [/h3] 
[list]
[*] Purchase pallets and pallet wrap from Shushan. No more waiting till the next day to restock your important supplies!
[*] FUTURE: ...
[/list]

[*] [h3] After Hours Shipping [/h3] 
[list]
[*] Request additional shipping once per day 
[*] FUTURE: ...
[/list]

[*] [h3] General Shipping [/h3] 
[list]
[*] More fluid mechanics while selecting which orders you want to ship out  
[*] FUTURE: ...
[/list]

[*] [h3] Auto-Save [/h3] 
[list]
[*] Automatically saves your progress every 5 minutes
[*] FUTURE: Will be toggleable with adjustable times.
[/list]

[*] [h3] Save-games [/h3] 
[list]
[*] Check box added to be able to bulk-delete save files 
[*] FUTURE: ...
[/list]

[h3] Probably more that I've either forgotten or didn't write down [/h3] 

[/list]
[/expand]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45204626/2fa869d1e83a27264f5c66aa0253608548c5c8f2.png[/img]
[expand type=showmore expanded=false]
[list]
[*] [h3] Orders [/h3] 
[list]
[*] Changed the maximum amount of NEW orders to reduce clutter and stress
[*] Day 1 will ensure there's at least 3 active orders to keep you moving and active
[*] FUTURE: ...
[/list]

[*] [h3] PalletJack [/h3] 
[list]
[*] Removed Character hit box 
[*] No longer able to exit the pallet jack through a wall
[*] [h3]FUTURE:[/h3] 
[list]
[*] Re-work how the pallet jack attaches/detaches from objects
[/list]
[/list]

[h3]Again, there's probably more but it's not documented right now[/h3]
[/list]
[/expand]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45204626/8ccbd52385f83d1d5f93370793540e0718d08899.png[/img]
[expand type=showmore expanded=false]
  [list]
    [*] Changed the text to for the carrying items help text
    [*] Added half pallets to "Amashlong"
    [*] Adjusted how products spawn 
    [*] using ESC while on the computer now closes the menu
    [*] Fixed "Overwrite" being disabled
    [*] Selecting "Next Day Shipping" will adjust the cart price accordingly
    [*] Removing item from cart now actually removes it
    [*]  Cleaned up a dirt pile behind Shushans Shop Shupplysh that was causing issues
    [*] Maple syrup was showing up as Chocolate Sauce
    [*] Added icons for pallet wraps
    [*] Added more bugs...
  [/list]

[/expand]
